title: The Great Moonberry Bounce
premise: When Yeti insists on delivering a basket of overripe, extra-bouncy moonberries by himself, one clever shortcut turns Mossy Hollow into a purple pinball course.
character_want: Yeti wants to prove he can handle an important market delivery without anyone checking on him.
emotional_need: He needs to understand that being responsible includes telling the truth and asking for help before a problem grows.
lesson: Asking for help and owning a mistake are parts of responsibility, not signs that you have failed.
hook_summary: An overripe moonberry blasts from breakfast, ricochets around the kitchen, and lands neatly in Yeti's basket just as he volunteers to deliver the whole batch.
ending_image: One overlooked berry launches a tiny flatcake; Yeti calmly catches it in the now-empty delivery basket while everybody raises an eyebrow.

production.notes: Example planning package only; no episode or media has been produced.
